Add a performance warning beside **Show all dated notes** in settings.

The warning explains that enabling this option in a vault with many files can significantly slow down the interface, and that unchecking it restores normal performance.

The README and settings screenshot include the same guidance. Validated with all twenty-eight unit tests, official Obsidian lint, strict TypeScript, package checks and an in-app inspection in the canonical development vault.

Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later. Install `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` below. GitHub Actions builds, checks, attests and verifies all three files before publication.
